Class PersistenceManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.persistence.PersistenceManager
public class PersistenceManager extends Object
Main coordinator responsible for managing persistent game save files on disk.

This manager provides synchronous transactional access to read, write, or drop game session snapshots. It encapsulates a Jackson ObjectMapper configured with structural indentation and relies on a GameSnapshotMapper to separate runtime domain mechanics from flat JSON storage nodes.

Data Integrity Guardrails: To guarantee fault-tolerant write routines and protect saves from unexpected server breakdowns, power outages, or data corruptions, updates are marshaled into an intermediate temporary file before being committed to the main target path via an atomic move command sequence.

    • saveGame

      public void saveGame(Game game)
      Serializes and writes the current state of a live Game session onto disk in a thread-safe manner.

      This operation dynamically checks and builds missing parent container folders, flattens the domain tree into a snapshot schema, maps it into a temporary mirror file (suffix .tmp), and replaces the existing asset file atomically.

      Parameters:
      game - the live Game engine context to be persistently encoded
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if an underlying IOException compromises file handles, disk sectors, or serialization routines

    • loadGame

      public Game loadGame()
      Reads, deserializes, and re-hydrates a saved game backup file into a functional runtime Game engine instance.
      Returns:
      a live, executable Game instance restored to the exact state it was in when saved
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the file data is unreadable, corrupted, or incompatible with the current structural domain entities

    • deleteSave

      public void deleteSave()
      Deletes the persistent save file from disk if it exists, effectively clearing the backup state.

      This method is typically invoked when a game session concludes naturally, ensuring that old, completed match states are not accidentally reloaded on subsequent server restarts.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the file cannot be deleted due to permission restrictions or access lockouts
